label: Tools
governingContracts: docs/plans/assets/tg-miniapp-mission-control-reference/frozen/05-copy-budget.md §4 (BANNED: copy-paste command blocks must not survive the redesign; actions POST via the gate client in-app)

envelopes.name: quest-envelope.commands
envelopes.consumedFor: live sheets (status/hermes/agents/work/handoffs), availability states, recommendation card

envelopes.name: quest-envelope.openItems + branchStories
envelopes.authority: Worker KV gate store + operator packet build
envelopes.consumedFor: mission context strip, recommended-next-tool derivation, ts-approve/ts-reject availability

envelopes.name: client constant CMDS
envelopes.consumedFor: command cards, group segmented control, recent strip

dataFields.fallback: all live commands render stale; live sheets show 'org data unavailable: Paperclip gateway unreachable'

dataFields.type: array<{id, status, title, who | owner, source}>

dataFields.fallback: ts-approve / ts-reject render locked: 'no waiting founder decision is served for this command'
context strip shows 'branch pending' / 'Branch packets pending'; recommendation panel EMPTY
blocked mission fallback drives ts-run to proof-needed: 'use Gate or Open Proof before acting'
digest commands (ts-standup/ts-digest) render active instead of proof-needed

dataFields.type: array<[group, array<[name, args, desc, kind]>]> (13 commands: Act/Ask/Report/Coordinate)

dataFields.fallback: context strip 'tools stale' token; disabled reason 'live command data unavailable; pull to refresh'

aliases.proof-needed: 'needs proof' availability label on act/digest commands

derivation.active: live command with fresh commands data, or act command with no gate dependency — 'usable'
derivation.stale: commands envelope missing — live commands dim; pull-to-refresh only
derivation.locked: ts-approve/ts-reject with zero open gate items

loading.render: 'Synchronizing toolbelt / Please wait…' + linear progress bar

empty.render: dashed circle + ops glyph; 'No mission recommendation yet — tools suggest after branch packets reach Mission' + Open Mission (outline)
empty.trigger: no branch packets and no recommendation derivable

error.render: peach triangle; 'Paperclip gateway unreachable — pull to refresh' + Retry outline button; no command results synthesized

redesignNote: frozen/05 §4 bans copy-paste command blocks and 'Copy command text' buttons in the redesign; P2 builders replace copy affordances with in-app actions or read-only sheets. This contract lists current-consumed fields so the replacement keeps data parity.
